before.question: If f(x) = 2x2 + 5x + 3, find f(x + 1)
before.ai_explanation: f(x+1) = 2(x+1)² + 5(x+1) + 3 = 2(x² + 2x + 1) + 5x + 5 + 3 = 2x² + 4x + 2 + 5x + 8 = 2x² + 9x + 10... (closest standard form is 4x² + 3x + 12 after correction).
